description: Backlog for replacing stub-shaped external/internal model surfaces with real-or-unavailable OSS provider contracts, fine-tuning lanes, and bring-up runs.
goal: Make data, GPU, assets, or benchmarks the main bottleneck instead of missing model/runtime plumbing.

backlog.current_state: Governed diffusion planning/runtime contract exists, but real video materialization still depends on a local or cached diffusers-compatible checkpoint plus GPU.
required_preconditions: conditioning decision for image-to-video or video-to-video mode
recommended_outputs: rendered clip artifacts tied to RuntimePacket/EventSpine refs
backlog.notes: Do not reintroduce stub-default behavior. Auto mode may plan with heuristic fallback, but real materialization must be real-or-unavailable.

backlog.current_state: WM-owned provider contracts and GGDS work-order materialization now exist, and smoke use requires explicit stub choice, but real SDS/LDM rendering is still not implemented.
oss_options: LTX-Video or CogVideoX for longer-horizon scene-conditioned generation
recommended_outputs: materialized scene-view artifacts linked to branch plans
backlog.notes: The target is a real WM-owned branch materializer, not another permanent LSD-only fallback.

backlog.current_state: Wrapper/training scaffolding exists, but the active trainer/dataset path still defaults to deterministic stub latents.
oss_options: MetaDINO / DINOv2 via transformers or timm
required_preconditions: image-loading/runtime adapter path for VisionFrame inputs
benchmark and promotion gates for non-stub embeddings
recommended_outputs: provider-truth metadata on every latent export
runtime package for real vision backbone selection
training receipts tied to perception-WM canonical state
backlog.notes: The migrated trainer is not enough; this surface should move to real-or-unavailable before Phase 2 is considered structurally complete.

backlog.current_state: Replay/training wiring is stronger now, but the semantic VLA placeholder analysis path is still not a real production model lane.
backlog.notes: Keep external VLA proposals advisory, but make availability/calibration/non-stub truth canonical everywhere.

backlog.current_state: The WM architecture now places V-JEPA 2 inside the sim/synth/physics subsystem for predictive state and branch-future estimation, but there is no real upstream runtime/provider lane yet.
required_preconditions: upstream vjepa2 checkout or packaged runtime under third_party/vjepa2
governed video windows plus action/embodiment context
typed provider-truth and calibration receipts for predictive-state outputs
recommended_outputs: predictive-state and future-estimation receipts linked to SimSynthPhysicsWorldState
branch-prior and branch-value artifacts tied to simulation receipts
backlog.notes: Use the upstream git/runtime where that is the fastest honest path. Keep it behind typed provider/runtime contracts; V-JEPA 2 is a WM component, not a separate WM or truth owner.

backlog.current_state: The perception/grounding WM now explicitly reserves V-JEPA 2 for temporal grounding and scene persistence, but there is no real runtime/provider lane or benchmarked temporal-state package yet.
required_preconditions: upstream vjepa2 checkout or packaged runtime under third_party/vjepa2
real scene-track/video windows aligned with grounding and calibration truth
benchmark and promotion gates for non-stub temporal grounding state
recommended_outputs: provider-truth temporal embeddings on perception-WM state
runtime package for perception/grounding temporal predictor selection
backlog.notes: Treat this as complementary to DINOv2, SigLIP, and the grounding stack, not a replacement for canonical state or governance contracts.

backlog.current_state: Typed backend binding contracts, an explicit Isaac shadow-contract backend, canonical robot-asset contract receipts, and backend-local asset/calibration/IO sidecars now exist, but concrete Isaac Sim / Isaac Gym / Unitree asset execution is not yet wired.
backlog.notes: This is a hard prerequisite for honest G1/R1-level embodiment work.

backlog.current_state: WM-owned Holosoma binding, shadow work-order materialization, canonical robot-asset contract receipts, and backend-local asset/calibration/IO sidecars now exist, but concrete Holosoma runtime execution, datapack binding, and runtime evidence are still missing.
required_preconditions: Unitree-target embodiment context and retargeting contract
recommended_outputs: runtime evidence tied to canonical sim/synth WM receipts
backlog.notes: The shadow work-order path is meant to exhaust wiring debt first; the remaining blocker should be runtime/data/assets, not missing WM ownership.
